name: Forgiven Those Who Hurt You
overview: Scripture calls believers to forgive those who hurt them, emphasizing that forgiveness is not optional but essential for receiving God's own forgiveness, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 6:14 and Mark 11:25. While human tendency may lean towards resentment, Jesus challenges this by instructing His followers to love even their enemies (Matthew 5:43) and to seek reconciliation with those who offend them (Matthew 18:15). The dialogue between Peter and Jesus in Matthew 18:21 underscores the boundless nature of forgiveness believers are to extend. Ultimately, the Lord hears the cries of the righteous and delivers them from trouble (Psalms 34:17), empowering them to forgive as He has forgiven.
